{{Quote|I'm only a mobile hold-tender&hellip; ''not'' the ship's computer!|A mobile hold-tender|<ref name="SW50" />}}
The '''mobile hold-tender''' was a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]].

==History==
{{Quote|That's ''typical''&hellip; Blame the poor ''droid!'' I'm only following ''programmed procedure''&hellip; But go ''ahead'', get angry at ''me''.|A mobile hold-tender|<ref name="SW50" />}}
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], a mobile hold-tender served aboard the ''[[Nova Prince]]''. It was in charge of waking up the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] held aboard the [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighter]].<ref name="SW50" />
